Adjacent span[data-as=p] elements convert like paragraphs

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<div><span data-as="p">First paragraph.</span><span data-as="p">Second paragraph.</span></div>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
